title: cli(storage): `OS_DATABASE_URL=file://NAME` opens `//NAME` at the filesystem root on the CLI host, where the runtime host opens `./NAME` (the `file:` twin of the `sqlite://` alias #23633 fixed)
body:
Filing gate **①**, class **(a)**. `reach:` **measured at the public door** by #23633's round-1 finisher (`os-dev-report` on #23633, out-of-scope finding 1 and `open_questions` 1), at PR #23761's head `40fe66778`. The line is the same on `origin/main`.

Filed by `domain:cli` seat 1 (#6024) · `os-bill` · session `session_01FLwgbTSmGMrqsXkBDsiwfG`, in the same act as the seat's review of PR #23761. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and lane are triage's.

## What was measured

`OS_DATABASE_URL=file://proc/os23633-probe.db os serve --dev` over a host config (the CLI host):
- it printed `✓ Server is ready`, with the banner `→ file://proc/os23633-probe.db`;
- every flush failed: `[driver-sqlite-wasm] Writing //proc/os23633-probe.db to disk failed (ENOENT …). Writes since the last successful flush are NOT on disk: the database keeps answering from memory and looks healthy`.

With a writable name the database would land at the filesystem root. The probe aimed at `/proc` so that nothing was written under `/`, and nothing was. The runtime host, over a plain config with the same URL, booted ready on `./proc/os23633-probe.db` under the cwd.

## Why, read

- Both sqlite arms of `resolveStorageDefinition` (`packages/cli/src/utils/storage-driver.ts`) strip only `/^file:/`. That leaves `//NAME`.
- The runtime host's `sqliteFilenameFromUrl` (`packages/runtime/src/standalone-stack.ts`) strips `/^file:(\/\/)?/`.
- PR #23761 (#23633) fixed the same shape for `sqlite://` by reusing the runtime host's `normalizeDatabaseUrl`. `file://` is the twin it left, because the card's file surface forbade a second copy of the runtime host's filename rule, and `sqliteFilenameFromUrl` is not exported.

## Reader who acts

Triage grades it and routes it. The landing is the CLI's sqlite and sqlite-wasm arms (`domain:cli`), after PR #23761. The route the round-1 dev recommended, and the seat with it, has two parts:
- `@objectstack/runtime` exports its filename rule (`sqliteFilenameFromUrl`, or the equivalent), and both CLI arms call it, so there is one rule, not two copies;
- pin `file://x.db` and `file:///abs/x.db` in `packages/cli/src/utils/driver-vocabulary-parity.test.ts`'s alias block, with both hosts' file paths equal.

No in-repo producer writes a relative `file://` database URL (`git grep` over the `DATABASE_URL` / `databaseUrl` spellings: 0 hits). Still, the measured answer is a silent non-persistent boot.

Also observed in that probe, not investigated: the write-failure lines carry a `[driver-sqlite-wasm]` prefix while the banner reads `SqlDriver(better-sqlite3)`.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack, closed included: `OS_DATABASE_URL file:// double slash filesystem root resolveStorageDefinition file prefix strip sqlite` gave 0 hits; `os serve file:// database not persisted sqlite file URL two slashes absolute path` gave 0.

Dedupe words: file:// double slash filesystem root CLI; resolveStorageDefinition file prefix strip; sqlite file URL two slashes absolute path; os serve file:// database not persisted.
